name: Reduce stuck bead retry ceiling
hypothesis: Beads like ralph-runner-jje (6 failures) consume iterations without succeeding. Capping retries at 2 and auto-skipping with a decomposition comment will save 4+ wasted iterations per stuck bead
change: Set MaxConsecutiveSkips to 2 in gromit.yaml and ensure the skip handler adds a bd comment suggesting the bead be decomposed
measurement: Compare total wasted iterations on stuck beads before vs after. Target: reduce from current average of 3.5 failures per stuck bead to max 2
risk: Some beads may succeed on attempt 3 with escalation. The MaxConsecutiveSkips config already exists, so this is a tuning change rather than new code
